craft_notes: Sthāyin: instant-leaving (yat-tat-tena-tatra-tadā: the pointer-chain stammers; each place left the moment mind is there). Rows: row 1 (chain uncut — the stammer IS the method). Close: may be (optative — waveless permitted). Rejected: smoothing the pointers — killed: that-that-by-that kept (Sanskrit's own grammar); 'stillness' — killed: waveless kept (nistaraṅga: no-wave, water-image intact).

lines: Wherever mind — that, that by that at that moment:
non-standing left — waveless then may be.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yatra yatra mano yāti tat tat tenaiva tatkṣaṇam | parityajyānavasthityā nistaraṅgas tato bhavet

reads_against.argmap: What becomes waveless? → Instant self-leaving of each place leaves mind waveless.
c1_essence: Wherever mind goes, that instant leaving non-standing: waveless.
